name: high_risk_not_step_up_gated
description: Decouple proof (counterpart to golden 04): step-up is keyed on the tool NAME (delete_dataset), not the risk tier. A high-risk tool that is NOT delete_dataset (example-operations.admin.rotate_credentials) carries no step-up forbid, so an mcp-admins caller WITHOUT mcp:invoke:high is allowed straight through on the role-allow path — `high` no longer implies a step-up prompt.
